classification_policy.PASS: Only with complete pass contract and independent evaluation.
classification_policy.PARTIAL: Only when requirement-specific observed evidence exists but full PASS contract is incomplete.
classification_policy.HOLD: Only when a requirement-specific probe/evaluation is blocked after evidence collection began.
classification_policy.FAIL: Only when an executed/observed requirement-specific test contradicts the requirement.
classification_policy.NOT_AUDITED: Use when responsibility/candidate surfaces can be identified but no requirement-specific behavioral evidence has yet been established.

normalization.profile_semantics: Every requirement record resolves candidate artifacts, evidence requirements, evaluator state, dependencies and blockers through its exact traceability-section profile. This avoids repeating identical section-level responsibility data 512 times while retaining exactly 512 requirement records.
